title: Bar Avuha
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Berakhot 53b](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.53b.11): Abaye recites the blessing (over the lights of the fire) at the house of Bar Abuha. Hyman attributes the reading “Bar Chavu” to Dikdukei Soferim and Yuchasin and regards it as correct.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Hyman judges Bar Chavu to be the correct reading and attributes it to Dikdukei Soferim and Yuchasin.
The linked Bavli reads Bar Avuh. [Heilprin’s Bar Chavu entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=787&lang=en) gives the alternative spelling in the same notice about Abaye’s blessing.
